info.name: Sitecore CDP REST Audit Templates API

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Number of items to return per page

params.name: pageOffset
params.description: Number of records to skip for pagination

params.name: sort
params.description: Field name and direction to sort results by (e.g., name:asc)

items.docs: Retrieves a paginated collection of all templates configured in the Sitecore Personalize instance. Templates define the visual or logic components used within personalization flows.
Creates a new template in Sitecore Personalize. Templates contain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript that define the visual presentation or decision logic of a personalization experience.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier of the resource

items.docs: Retrieves a specific template by its unique identifier. Returns the full template including its code, revision history, and status.

items.docs: Performs a full replacement update of a template. A new revision is created upon each update.
